title: 心室輔助幫浦流場模擬
summary: 以「旋轉幫浦的網格、流量與回流區」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「只檢收斂殘差而不驗質量守恆」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Mesh, flow and recirculation in pump simulations, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Checking residuals without mass conservation.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.title: 單元1｜平均流速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Mean flow velocity: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「旋轉幫浦的網格、流量與回流區」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Mesh, flow and recirculation in pump simulations with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「旋轉幫浦的網格、流量與回流區」的「平均流速」採以下合成教學值：flow=0.002 m³/s；area=0.01 m²。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 flow/area；獨立基準為 0.2 m/s。把 flow 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 0.22 m/s。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Mesh, flow and recirculation in pump simulations, use synthetic inputs for Mean flow velocity: flow=0.002 m³/s；area=0.01 m². Check dimensions before evaluating flow/area; the independent benchmark is 0.2 m/s. Increase flow by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 0.22 m/s. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: flow增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 0.02 m/s。不代表局部峰值、混合均勻度或接觸時間分布。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 0.02 m/s. It does not give local peaks, mixing uniformity or residence-time distribution.
steps.failure: 只檢收斂殘差而不驗質量守恆；不代表局部峰值、混合均勻度或接觸時間分布。
steps.failureEn: Checking residuals without mass conservation; It does not give local peaks, mixing uniformity or residence-time distribution.
steps.check: 原值重算與 0.2 m/s 相符；10%案例與 0.22 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 0.2 m/s at baseline and 0.22 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（m/s）？
quiz.explanation: 按 flow/area 逐項代入，結果為 0.2；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into flow/area gives 0.2; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜平均流速：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Mean flow velocity: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「旋轉幫浦的網格、流量與回流區」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Mesh, flow and recirculation in pump simulations with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「旋轉幫浦的網格、流量與回流區」設計「平均流速」的獨立驗證：以定時集液法交叉核對流量計，量實際內徑並確認旁路。 數位或惰性台架的流量、壓差與質量須同步記錄，不能把模型負載視為真實受試者。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Mesh, flow and recirculation in pump simulations, independently verify Mean flow velocity: Cross-check the meter by timed collection, measure internal diameter and inspect bypasses. Synchronize flow, pressure and mass in digital/inert benches; surrogates are not real subjects. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「只檢收斂殘差而不驗質量守恆」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Checking residuals without mass conservation rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 只檢收斂殘差而不驗質量守恆；不代表局部峰值、混合均勻度或接觸時間分布。
steps.failureEn: Checking residuals without mass conservation; It does not give local peaks, mixing uniformity or residence-time distribution.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不代表局部峰值、混合均勻度或接觸時間分布。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state It does not give local peaks, mixing uniformity or residence-time distribution.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？

只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
optionsEn: Retain raw data and perform: Cross-check the meter by timed collection, measure internal diameter and inspect bypasses.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.

steps.title: 單元1｜平均流速：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Mean flow velocity: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「旋轉幫浦的網格、流量與回流區」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Mesh, flow and recirculation in pump simulations with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「只檢收斂殘差而不驗質量守恆」。以本單元「平均流速」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「以定時集液法交叉核對流量計，量實際內徑並確認旁路。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Checking residuals without mass conservation. For Mean flow velocity, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Cross-check the meter by timed collection, measure internal diameter and inspect bypasses. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「只檢收斂殘差而不驗質量守恆」不是單靠 0.2 m/s 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 0.2 m/s alone cannot exclude Checking residuals without mass conservation; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 只檢收斂殘差而不驗質量守恆；不代表局部峰值、混合均勻度或接觸時間分布。
steps.failureEn: Checking residuals without mass conservation; It does not give local peaks, mixing uniformity or residence-time distribution.
steps.check: 交付單元1的五項證據包；清楚寫出「旋轉幫浦的網格、流量與回流區」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 1, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Mesh, flow and recirculation in pump simulations and retaining failed cases.

steps.check: 原值重算與 20 W 相符；10%案例與 22 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 20 W at baseline and 22 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（W）？
quiz.explanation: 按 pressure*flow/efficiency 逐項代入，結果為 20；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into pressure*flow/efficiency gives 20; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 流體功率為壓差乘流率，除效率得到理想化輸入功率。
knowledge.textEn: Fluid power is pressure difference times flow; divide by efficiency for idealized input power.

steps.title: 單元2｜壓差功率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Pressure-flow power: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「旋轉幫浦的網格、流量與回流區」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Mesh, flow and recirculation in pump simulations with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「旋轉幫浦的網格、流量與回流區」設計「壓差功率」的獨立驗證：同步取壓差、流量和電功率，以空白迴路辨識管損。 數位或惰性台架的流量、壓差與質量須同步記錄，不能把模型負載視為真實受試者。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Mesh, flow and recirculation in pump simulations, independently verify Pressure-flow power: Synchronize pressure, flow and electrical power; use a blank loop to identify line losses. Synchronize flow, pressure and mass in digital/inert benches; surrogates are not real subjects. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「只檢收斂殘差而不驗質量守恆」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Checking residuals without mass conservation rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 只檢收斂殘差而不驗質量守恆；假設不可壓縮穩態且效率定值；不能跨不同工作點直接外推。
steps.failureEn: Checking residuals without mass conservation; Assumes incompressible steady flow and fixed efficiency; do not extrapolate across operating points.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「假設不可壓縮穩態且效率定值；不能跨不同工作點直接外推。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Assumes incompressible steady flow and fixed efficiency; do not extrapolate across operating points.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
保留原始資料並執行：同步取壓差、流量和電功率，以空白迴路辨識管損。
optionsEn: Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: Synchronize pressure, flow and electrical power; use a blank loop to identify line losses.

steps.title: 單元2｜壓差功率：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Pressure-flow power: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「旋轉幫浦的網格、流量與回流區」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Mesh, flow and recirculation in pump simulations with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「只檢收斂殘差而不驗質量守恆」。以本單元「壓差功率」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「同步取壓差、流量和電功率，以空白迴路辨識管損。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Checking residuals without mass conservation. For Pressure-flow power, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Synchronize pressure, flow and electrical power; use a blank loop to identify line losses. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「只檢收斂殘差而不驗質量守恆」不是單靠 20 W 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 20 W alone cannot exclude Checking residuals without mass conservation; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 只檢收斂殘差而不驗質量守恆；假設不可壓縮穩態且效率定值；不能跨不同工作點直接外推。
steps.failureEn: Checking residuals without mass conservation; Assumes incompressible steady flow and fixed efficiency; do not extrapolate across operating points.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「旋轉幫浦的網格、流量與回流區」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Mesh, flow and recirculation in pump simulations and retaining failed cases.
